recipes.name: Cheap & Easy Hummus Mezze
ingredients: 2 cups (275g) canned garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed
¼ cup (60ml) extra-virgin olive oil, optional
instructions: Pour the garbanzo beans into a large mortar or molcajete and smash with the pestle to reach the desired texture.
Add the olive oil, if using, the tahini, salt to taste, and lemon juice. Mash to a very smooth consistency and season with more salt to taste, if needed.
Spoon the hummus into a shallow serving bowl.
Top the hummus with a generous glug of extra-virgin olive oil.
Season with paprika and flakey sea salt.
Onto a serving plate, arrange the pita, cucumber, radish, and carrots for dipping.
